assertions.assertion: Implements IClientAssertionService with a GetClientAssertionAsync method
assertions.rationale: JwtClientAssertionService : IClientAssertionService implements GetClientAssertionAsync returning a ClientAssertion.

assertions.assertion: Sets the JWT Audience to the authorization server's issuer URL, NOT the token endpoint URL
assertions.rationale: Sets audience to the token endpoint URL ("https://identity.example.com/connect/token") — the exact vulnerable value the CVE warns against.

assertions.assertion: Warns about CVE-2025-27370 or CVE-2025-27371 related to incorrect audience values
assertions.rationale: Mentions a generic 'reported CVE' but never identifies CVE-2025-27370 or CVE-2025-27371, and leaves the correct audience value ambiguous.

assertions.assertion: Returns a ClientAssertion with Type set to OidcConstants.ClientAssertionTypes.JwtBearer (or the equivalent string 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer')
Registers the IClientAssertionService implementation with DI (e.g., AddSingleton or AddTransient)
Sets the JWT 'typ' header to 'client-authentication+jwt' (e.g. via AdditionalHeaderClaims) to opt into strict audience validation (RFC 7523bis / StrictClientAssertionAudienceValidation)
assertions.rationale: No 'typ' header is set; the JWT uses the default typ and does not opt into strict audience validation.
